title: 30001054: accept the four-axiom realization obstruction
body:
The four term axioms in the inspected 26 November 2006 Goodman-Pollack manuscript and official OWR44/2008 do not imply the prescribed connected-set encoding with compatible tangent and separating pseudolines. The primitive two-body period A,B,A,B,C,B,C,B has no mixed switch, contradicting the required internal-tangent records. A fully separated input term forces every ordered cross-body switch once; no polygonal construction is claimed.

The older stronger allowable-interval definitions and Habert-Pocchiola’s prior specified-fibration representation theorem are credited and remain intact. This is a source-bound historical-definition correction. Both bounded priority audits report PRIORITY_UNRESOLVED: no checked matching earlier literal negative was identified, but firstness and current worldwide openness are not certified. Final GP2008 and older cited GP2004 bodies remain unread.

Preprint: [A missing multiplicity condition for double-permutation sequences](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23414444), Alec Kriebel, v1.0, 16 October 2026. The deposit contains the exact reviewed four-page PDF and 123-member source/verification archive, preserving all 32 original files.

Validation: independent combinatorial/geometric audits, two bounded priority audits, and three fresh whole-package review rounds with both citation findings fixed globally and a zero-issue final round. Actual Python 3.14/3.12 normal/optimized replays, finite checks, physical corruption/relocation/rebuild and input-preservation checks passed. The PR diff is its own QUEUE row and 32 frozen original files; reviewed head c9a87710414d1d4ac5f21e84a81a7d3d40d4d094.

AI tools were used extensively. The note is unrefereed, without external human peer review or proof-assistant certification. [Audit, exact bindings and publication receipts](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/tree/main/draft_pr_claimed_solved_700_800_20261012/audits/pr778_30001054).
